default_thresholds_note: Governed conforming loan limit seeded into mip.ref.offer_rules_config under mip_conforming_loan_limit_usd (FHFA 2025 baseline one-unit limit). Applied by the gold CTAS from the ref table, NOT baked as a UDF default, so operators retune it annually without a SQL deploy.

cases.note: Happy path: conventional code, amount below the limit.
Conventional code with original amount strictly above the governed limit classifies as jumbo.
Boundary: a loan EXACTLY at the conforming limit is conforming by FHFA definition. The > contract means equality stays conventional; flipping to >= would fail this case loudly.
FHA maps to fha regardless of amount -- the jumbo overlay applies only to conventional first liens.
No source code -> NULL (unknown). A large amount alone must NOT be guessed as jumbo: without the code we cannot rule out FHA/VA.
Whitespace-only code is treated as missing.
A real but unmapped Cotality code (e.g. private-party) lands in other -- the signal is preserved, never dropped or guessed into a marketed bucket.
UPPER(TRIM(...)) normalization: lowercase/padded source codes still classify.
Missing original amount disables only the jumbo test; the code-mapped bucket still returns.
Missing governed limit disables only the jumbo test (misconfiguration must not inflate jumbo counts).
